description: The result of parsing a raw cell input string via SpreadsheetValueParser. Carries the typed value, the detected data type, an optional formula, an optional implied number format (applied only when the target cell still uses the General format), and a flag indicating the input was forced to text with a leading apostrophe.

members.name: Text
members.description: Creates a text result with the given string value.

members.name: Formula
members.description: The formula expression (including the leading =) when the input is a formula; otherwise null.

members.name: ImpliedNumberFormat
members.description: The number format implied by the input (e.g. 0%, #,##0.00), or null when no specific format is implied.

members.name: IsForcedText
members.description: Whether the input was explicitly forced to text via a leading apostrophe.

members.name: Type
members.description: The detected data type of the value.

members.name: Value
members.description: The typed value (e.g. double, bool, DateTime, or string). Null for formulas and empty input.
